summary: Close the remaining gateway structural debt in 2 execution slices: first collapse duplicated container and integration adapter ownership, then fence the deprecated web compatibility surface so Desktop plus MCP Gateway remains the only primary runtime path.

tasks.title: Collapse duplicated integration adapter ownership
tasks.description: Refactor the gateway seam so ServiceContainer, container adapters, and UnifiedMemoryEngine all consume one explicit integration adapter bundle from src-ts/integrations/adapters.ts instead of carrying placeholder factories or duplicated mini-adapter surfaces.
tasks.scope: Touch 4 scoped source files to remove duplicate boundary logic across ServiceContainer factory placeholders, adapter-side implicit bundle creation, integration stub or noop selection, and UnifiedMemoryEngine's reduced adapter shim.

criteria: 1 shared integration adapter ownership path exists in src-ts/integrations/adapters.ts and is consumed by 3 gateway callers: src-ts/container/ServiceContainer.ts, src-ts/container/adapters.ts, and src-ts/memory/unified-memory.ts
0 duplicate IntegrationFlags or createNoOpAdapters seams remain in src-ts/memory/unified-memory.ts

2 behavior modes are explicit for each optional boundary: local-first default and enabled integration path, with no ambiguous placeholder factory comment block left in src-ts/container/ServiceContainer.ts
convergence.verification: cd src-ts && npm.cmd run test -- tests/integrations/adapters.test.ts tests/memory/unified-memory.integration-adapters.test.ts tests/container/search-engine-adapter.default-constructor.test.ts tests/container/ServiceContainer.test.ts && npm.cmd run typecheck
convergence.definition_of_done: The adapter boundary is owned once, the container no longer presents core runtime factories as placeholders, UnifiedMemoryEngine no longer mirrors the integration bundle, and the listed tests plus typecheck pass.

implementation.title: Inventory current adapter ownership and call sites
implementation.description: Map how ServiceContainer, SearchEngineAdapter, and UnifiedMemoryEngine currently create or infer integration adapters, and separate placeholder naming from behavior that affects runtime registration.

implementation.title: Move boundary ownership to a single bundle contract
implementation.description: Adjust the integration factory and its consumers so adapter bundle creation and configuration is explicit and reusable instead of recreated or partially mirrored across container and memory layers.

implementation.title: Rebaseline coverage on the closed seam
implementation.description: Update the existing integration, memory, and container tests so they assert the new single-boundary behavior and catch regressions in both default local-first and enabled integration modes.

tasks.title: Fence the deprecated web gateway compatibility surface
tasks.description: After the adapter seam is closed, reduce the residual web compatibility path to an explicitly bounded fallback so GET / forwarding and websocket workflow behavior remain opt-in compatibility logic rather than a parallel primary surface.
tasks.scope: Touch 1 scoped source file, plus its existing tests, to keep src-ts/web/app.ts aligned with the post-refactor gateway boundary and the current Desktop plus MCP Gateway authority model.

criteria: 1 deprecated HTTP root policy remains in src-ts/web/app.ts: default 410 response with validated forwarding only when WEB_UI_FORWARD_URL is explicitly set
1 websocket compatibility policy remains opt-in and continues to advertise Desktop client or MCP Gateway as the primary path
0 new runtime dependencies from src-ts/web/app.ts back into the core gateway integration bundle are introduced
convergence.verification: cd src-ts && npm.cmd run test -- tests/web/app.test.ts && npm.cmd run typecheck
convergence.definition_of_done: The deprecated web surface is explicitly bounded, aligns with the closed gateway integration boundary from A1, and the web compatibility tests plus typecheck pass.

implementation.title: Align compatibility behavior with the primary runtime boundary
implementation.description: Review root-route forwarding, websocket gating, and user-facing deprecation messaging in src-ts/web/app.ts against the Desktop plus MCP Gateway authority path established by the gateway module.

implementation.title: Remove residual ambiguity from the web fallback surface
implementation.description: Tighten the implementation so compatibility-only behavior stays explicit, does not imply a first-class web runtime, and does not reopen the broader compatibility seam closed in A1.

implementation.title: Lock the bounded behavior with existing tests
implementation.description: Refresh src-ts/tests/web/app.test.ts assertions to cover the final 410, validated forwarding, and websocket gating behavior expected after the module closure.

risks: SearchEngineAdapter and UnifiedMemoryEngine already have behavior tests tied to current noop and stub semantics, so changing adapter ownership can break runtime assumptions unless tests are updated in the same slice.
src-ts/web/app.ts is already documented as a bounded deprecated surface; removing it outright instead of fencing it would conflict with current migration and security documents.
ServiceContainer has broad singleton and mock-injection coverage, so careless DI refactoring can regress initialization order or testing hooks beyond the integration seam.
out_of_scope: Any authority or governance hardening already completed in WFS-post-governance-hardening-20260407
Desktop API client or Tauri contract splitting outside the scoped gateway files
Repo-wide lint, format, or local baseline work
Knowledge surface or Story Bible product-surface closure work
